scripts.name: Scheduled Restart
scripts.description: Gracefully warns players, saves the world and restarts the server process on a fixed interval to clear memory.

scripts.name: Discord Status Webhook
scripts.description: Posts live player count, server status and join notifications to a configured Discord channel.

scripts.name: Nightly Backup
scripts.description: Zips the save folder and config files to a timestamped archive, keeping the last 14 days of backups.
